body.en: When certain prepositions or adverbs are placed after some verbs, the meaning of the verb changes. Verbs with such a preposition or adverb are called phrasal verbs or group verbs. For example — 'bring' means to fetch, but 'bring up' means to rear/nurture. Here 'bring up' is a phrasal verb or group verb. In this chapter, first a list of the group verbs that have appeared in past examinations has been given. Secondly, the important group verbs have been written in detail with examples.
